features: Separate world and hand/HUD layers for parallel Simple and FSR
Native FSR worker context with lifecycle reset
Right-click exact integer entry without early config save
Motion grid 1–16, search 4–128, subpixel refinement 0–4, distortion protection
limitations: Hand/HUD stay at source update rate; world interpolation adds about one source frame of latency
No perfect reconstruction at 1–2 real FPS or behind newly revealed surfaces
Highest quality costs substantial GPU work and VRAM
Invert-color crosshair is white; custom destination-dependent HUD blending may differ
Parallel mode is Windows-only and excludes shader packs, Fabulous and camera post-effects
